# imoves

> imoves is a UK platform of ready-to-use primary school PE, active learning, movement break (Active Blasts), dance, gymnastics and wellbeing resources, made so that non-specialist teachers can get children moving throughout the school day with less planning. AfPE Approved Curriculum Resource. 4,000+ lessons and activities. Used by UK primary schools for over 10 years. Published by imoves active education ltd, 109 Rustlings Road, Sheffield, S11 7AB. Phone +44 114 266 1061. Email kirsty@imoves.com.

Teachers log in and use the resources at https://platform.imoves.com. Schools subscribe per product and per key stage; current prices are on the pricing page. A free 28-day trial is available at https://platform.imoves.com/sign-up.
